raw.rationale: A PDE4A inhibitor at 2.5 µM for 5 days is unlikely to show lineage-selective cytotoxicity because PDE4 inhibition is cytostatic/anti-inflammatory rather than broadly cytotoxic, and PRISM single-concentration viability screens rarely yield lineage-selective killing for non-chemotherapy launched drugs. Any apparent selectivity would most likely reflect lineage-specific PDE4A dependence or transporter/efflux differences, but base rates remain low.
